name: Al Austin
office: Water Replenishment District of Southern California, Member, Board of Directors, Division 3

items.text: Al Austin is a Long Beach utilities commissioner and former councilmember. His campaign says he directs politics and legislation for AFSCME Council 57. His campaign priorities include protecting groundwater, investing in water infrastructure, and fiscal responsibility. As councilmember, he was president of the Gateway Cities Council of Governments and worked on the I-710 Corridor Project. A court barred his “Long Beach Water Commissioner” ballot designation, finding it misleading.
